image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on a grey, textured surface. The bird displays characteristic breeding male plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast and belly, and black upperparts with white wing bars. The bill is conical and dark. The legs are visible, appearing pinkish-brown, gripping the ground.
